note: 7 Nov - 6 Dec. Data month Sep 2026. Held for the NBFC ingest (user, 2026-11-06): #12 bank credit to NBFCs, #16 NBFC retail. Release days #24, #28 wait on RBI. #27 off-site ATMs held: the dashboard ATM table is titled On-site + Off-site but shows on-site only. #9 keeps shops only: online value carries a share step and a large base. UPI QR market growth (+24.9%) is not quoted: most of the month's addition is Axis's one-month step.
